justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/decoder/Decoder.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/AztecReader.java, core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/decoder/DecoderTest.java, and core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/encoder/EncoderTest.java.
